{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Cobble Crusher Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Cobble Crusher Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |cost= |value= |location= |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Goron Gear|Goron Gear|Series, BotW}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 171}}{{Name Ref|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Goron Gear is a group of [[Weapon]]s crafted by the [[Goron]]s. Most of these items are powerful two-handed Weapons made from thick, hard metal; these lack cutting edges, and instead rely on their weight and the force of the swing to crush opponents.{{Cite|{{Big|Cobble Crusher}}
A Goron-made two-handed weapon. It's made from thick, hard metal and has no cutting edge, so it relies on its sheer weight to crush all opponents.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Stone Smasher}}
A two-handed weapon forged from a rare metal mined in Goron City. Its center of gravity is at its tip, so it uses centrifugal force and its sheer weight to smash opponents flat.|Inventory|BotW}} All pieces of Goron Gear are made of metal. This means that they will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They do not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they can be picked up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. ====List of Equipment==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Item[Image][Nowrap][Term], Strength, Durability, Description[Transcript] |- | Cobble Crusher | 15 | 30 | A Goron-made two-handed weapon.
